description: Update the Japanese README to document the realtime multiplayer battle feature end to end: architecture (API Gateway WebSocket API + ws Lambda + DynamoDB with TTL, cost-minimal posture), the host-auth model (existing Cognito Hosted UI; the host logs in from the public app), participant join by room ID (no login, display name only), the game flow, the new WS_URL / VITE_WS_URL Amplify env var, the new WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput, and the updated deploy/verification steps. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 being implemented so the documented names/outputs match the code.
steps: Add a new README.md section (Japanese) describing the realtime battle (リアルタイム対戦): the flow (ホストがルーム作成 -> ルームID共有 -> 参加者が名前+ルームIDで参加 -> ホスト開始 -> 同じ問題を同期配信 -> 参加者個人スコアのライブ順位表), that questions come from the existing registered quizzes, and that scoring is server-side (the correct answerIndex is never sent to participant clients).

Document the architecture additions: a NEW API Gateway v2 WebSocket API + a dedicated ARM64 ws Lambda + reuse of the existing DynamoDB single table with a TTL attribute (ttl) for auto-expiring rooms/connections; emphasize the cost-minimal posture (on-demand DynamoDB, no VPC/NAT, connection/duration billing only, idle ~zero). Note it is additive and does not change the existing HTTP API.

Document the host-auth model: the host must log in with the existing Cognito admin account via Hosted UI (now also allowed to redirect back to the public app /index.html); participants are unauthenticated and only provide a display name + room ID. Note the AdminAppClient callback/logout URLs now include /index.html.

Document the new Amplify env var WS_URL (mapped by amplify.yml to VITE_WS_URL) set to the CDK WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput, alongside the existing API_BASE / COGNITO_DOMAIN / COGNITO_CLIENT_ID vars. Update the deploy-after-CDK and Amplify-env-var sections accordingly.

Update the CfnOutputs list and the deploy/verification steps to include WebSocketEndpoint and the commands: root `npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth` then `npx cdk deploy`; frontend `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`; then set the WS_URL Amplify env var and redeploy.
acceptance_criteria: README.md has a Japanese section describing the realtime battle flow, host-auth (Cognito), participant join-by-roomID (no login), and server-side scoring (answerIndex never exposed).
README.md documents the WebSocket API + ws Lambda + DynamoDB TTL architecture and the cost-minimal posture, and states the feature is additive to the existing HTTP API.
README.md documents the new WS_URL / VITE_WS_URL Amplify env var and the WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput, and the deploy/verification steps reflect them.
The documented env var names, output names, and route/flow names match the code delivered in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
verification: Read README.md and confirm the new section is internally consistent with lib/quiz-app-stack.ts (WebSocketEndpoint output, ttl), amplify.yml (WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL), config.ts (VITE_WS_URL), and the ws action/message contract.
Confirm no non-README source behavior was changed by this docs feature (git diff limited to README.md, aside from prior features).
findings:
Docs-only change: README.md updated to document the realtime battle (リアルタイム対戦) feature end to end. No source/behavior files touched (git diff limited to README.md + this feature file). No build/test needed for a docs change; INTEGRATIONS_ONLY anyway. Verified all documented names against the actual code: lib/quiz-app-stack.ts (timeToLiveAttribute:'ttl', CfnOutput 'WebSocketEndpoint', grantManageConnections, WebSocketStage stageName 'prod', 6 action routes createRoom/joinRoom/startGame/submitAnswer/nextQuestion/endGame + $connect/$disconnect/$default, index.html callback/logout URLs added to AdminAppClient), amplify.yml (WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL), frontend/src/config.ts (export const WS_URL from VITE_WS_URL).

SECTIONS ADDED/UPDATED in README.md:
- 概要: added a bullet summarizing リアルタイム対戦(②): host creates room, participants join by room ID + display name (no login), synced questions, live scoreboard, host-only Cognito login, WebSocket API, server-side scoring (answerIndex never sent to participants).
- アーキテクチャ list: updated バックエンド bullet to note the additional ws Lambda (lambda/ws.ts, Node 22/ARM64); updated データストア bullet to note battle items in the same table namespaced with TTL attr 'ttl' (QUIZ# unchanged).
- NEW top-level section '## リアルタイム対戦（②・ルームID方式）' with subsections: 対戦の流れ (6-step flow: ホストがルーム作成 -> ルームID共有 -> 参加者が名前+ルームIDで参加 -> ホスト開始 -> 同じ問題を同期配信 -> 参加者個人スコアのライブ順位表; room id = 6 chars excluding 0/O/1/I/L; name 1..40); 出題と採点 (questions from existing registered quizzes; server-side scoring using stored answerIndex; answerIndex NEVER sent to participant clients; 1 answer per question, only in in_question phase); 認証モデル (host must log in via existing Cognito Hosted UI from the public index.html; AdminAppClient callback/logout URLs now include /index.html alongside /admin.html; localhost:8080/index.html when includeLocalhostCallback; participants unauthenticated, name+roomId only, no token); アーキテクチャの追加点 (ASCII diagram + prose: NEW API Gateway v2 WebSocket API with $connect/$disconnect/$default + 6 action routes matched on body.action, stage 'prod' autoDeploy; dedicated ARM64 ws Lambda running the server-authoritative state machine lobby->in_question->between->finished and PostToConnection broadcast; reuse of existing DynamoDB single table with namespaced ROOM#/CONN#/PLAYER# items + reverse lookup and TTL attr 'ttl' ~6h auto-expire; additive, existing HTTP API/7 routes/JWT authorizer/single-player/admin/history/seeds unchanged); コスト面 (on-demand DynamoDB, WebSocket API connection/message billing, ARM64 Lambda scale-to-zero, no VPC/NAT, TTL free cleanup, idle ~zero).
- デプロイ後のセットアップ手順: added WebSocketEndpoint to the CfnOutput list (step 1) and WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL to the Amplify env var list (step 3).
- デプロイ手順 (Deploy): added WebSocketEndpoint to the post-deploy CfnOutput list and WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL to the Amplify Hosting env var list; added a note after the Cognito callback-URL update step explaining that /index.html is now an allowed callback/logout URL for the host, plus a blockquote instructing to set the Amplify env var WS_URL to WebSocketEndpoint and redeploy the frontend (amplify.yml maps WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL); note that if unset only the battle WS fails while single-player/admin are unaffected.
- 利用開始と動作確認 (Verify): added a リアルタイム対戦 verification bullet (host login -> create room -> share room id; second browser joins by name+roomId with no login; synced questions + live scoreboard; requires WS_URL/VITE_WS_URL).
- フロントエンドのローカル開発: added a comment that VITE_WS_URL (WebSocketEndpoint wss://.../prod) should be set in .env.local to try the battle locally.
- コスト最適化テーブル: added an 'API Gateway WebSocket API (v2)' row (connection-time + received-message billing, no idle fixed cost).
- テストについて: expanded the two test bullets to note the new WebSocket API / ws Lambda ARM64 / execute-api:ManageConnections / DynamoDB TTL 'ttl' / WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput assertions in quiz-app-stack.test.ts (HTTP API 7 routes + 1 JWT authorizer still unchanged) and the new ws.ts pure-helper tests in handler.test.ts (room id gen, scoreboard aggregation, game-state transitions, participant question projection dropping answerIndex, answer scoring, join validation).

STYLE NOTE ON EM DASHES: my authored prose uses no em dashes. The two new CfnOutput list entries use ' — ' as the label separator ONLY to stay consistent with the four existing entries in the same lists (README already uses '—' uniformly there); deviating would make the list visually inconsistent. All other additions avoid em dashes.
